meta.title: Locanda dei Gemelli | Restaurant, Pizzeria and Apartments in Dimaro Folgarida, Val di Sole
meta.description: Restaurant, pizzeria and 6 apartments in Dimaro Folgarida, Val di Sole: Trentino cooking with local ingredients, pizza by a master pizzaiolo and self-catering apartments sleeping 4 to 7.

hero.eyebrow: Restaurant · Pizzeria · Apartments · Dimaro Folgarida, Val di Sole
hero.title: Eat well. Sleep better. Under one roof.
hero.lead: Locanda dei Gemelli is a restaurant, a pizzeria and a holiday home in Val di Sole. Trentino cooking with ingredients from our valleys, pizza by our master pizzaiolo and 6 self-contained apartments in the same building.

0.title: Locally sourced
0.text: Producers from Val di Sole, Val di Non and the Adige Valley

1.title: Master pizzaiolo
1.text: Carefully made dough and seasonal ingredients

3.title: Lunch and dinner
3.text: Open 6 days a week, closed on Tuesdays

duo.title: Come for the food. Stay for the holiday.
duo.text: You don't have to choose between a good restaurant and a good place to sleep. Here you get both, run by the same people to the same standard.

food.title: Restaurant and pizzeria
food.text: Trentino cooking with a modern touch at lunch and dinner, master-made pizza in the evening, takeaway and delivery.

stay.title: 6 apartments
stay.text: Self-contained apartments of 46 to 60 m² with kitchen, private bathroom and Wi-Fi, for 4–7 people. Pets welcome.

manifesto.title: If we wouldn't serve it to our own family, it doesn't reach your table.
manifesto.text: You don't judge a restaurant by its furniture. You judge it by the plate. That's why we start with the raw ingredients: seasonal, traceable mountain produce from the farmers of our valleys. Then we treat them with respect, using the recipes of the Val di Sole and Trentino tradition and the technique of today.

0.title: Roots
0.text: The recipes we grew up with, from the Val di Sole and Trentino tradition. Every dish starts there.

1.title: Season
1.text: Our menu follows the mountains. We use what the valleys offer right now, at its best.

2.title: Craft
2.text: Modern technique in service of flavour, not show. Nothing on the plate that doesn't belong.

kitchen.title: Tradition, cooked for today.
kitchen.text: Trentino dishes with a modern hand, plus a few international plates for those who want to stray from the path. Fresh ingredients, honest portions, clear flavours. The lunch you need between ski runs and the dinner you remember at the end of your holiday.
kitchen.menu: The full menu will be available on this page soon.

pizza.title: Pizza is a craft. Our master knows it.
pizza.text: Every pizza comes from the hands of our master pizzaiolo. Carefully made dough, high-quality seasonal ingredients, well-judged pairings. You'll find the classics you love and special combinations created in our kitchen that you won't find anywhere else.

services.title: The same standard, wherever you want to eat.

0.title: Takeaway and delivery
0.text: Our cooking and our pizza, at your home or holiday apartment. Same care, same flavour.

1.title: Garden and events
1.text: Summer evenings outdoors, birthdays, group dinners and parties. The garden is ready for your event.

2.title: Business lunches and meetings
2.text: A private room, presentation equipment, coffee breaks, buffet or light lunch. You focus on the meeting, we take care of the rest.

apartments.title: Sleep a few steps from your table.
apartments.text: Six self-contained apartments, each with its own kitchen and private bathroom, so you can enjoy Val di Sole on your own terms. From 46 to 60 m², sleeping 4 to 7. Pets welcome, non-smoking throughout. And when you don't feel like cooking, the restaurant and pizzeria are on the ground floor.

quote.text: The valleys provide the ingredients. We bring the craft.

visit.title: In the heart of Val di Sole.
visit.text: We're in Dimaro Folgarida, a few minutes from the Folgarida-Marilleva lifts and right on the Val di Sole cycle path. The right place after a day of skiing, cycling or hiking.

book.text: Online booking through TheFork and a quick WhatsApp line are coming soon. In the meantime, we look forward to seeing you at Via Campiglio 59.
